title: Implement MealPlan Serialisation
description: Add `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` so parsed meal plans round-trip back to stable CookLang `.menu` text that reparses to an equivalent model, preserving the spec's formatting semantics where required.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` emits optional frontmatter, block headings, section headers, comments, and item lines in a form accepted by `parse(_:)`.
`serialise(parse(x))` reparses to an equal `MealPlan` for canonical sample content.
Whitespace and trailing-newline handling is stable enough for round-trip equality at the model level.

handoff_summary.completed: Added `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` plus private helpers to emit frontmatter, block headings, section headers, comments, recipe lines, ingredient lines, and quantity bodies in a form accepted by `parse(_:)`. Updated parsing so `--` comments inside a block open an implicit unnamed section when needed, allowing serializer output to round-trip comment-first unnamed sections. Verified the touched Swift sources typecheck with `xcrun swiftc -module-cache-path /private/tmp/swift-module-cache -typecheck Sources/CookbookCore/*.swift` from `Packages/CookbookCore`.
handoff_summary.risks: Serializer output is canonicalized rather than source-faithful: headings are emitted as `== <heading> ==`, metadata list syntax is flattened back to `key: value`, and numeric quantities may be normalized (for example `1/2` becomes `0.5`). This preserves model-level round-trip semantics but not original text formatting.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. The change is isolated to `MealPlanParser.swift`, but downstream tester/reviewer agents should evaluate parser behavior around canonicalized quantity/frontmatter formatting and unnamed-section comments.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a canonical serializer instead of attempting source-format preservation because the public model does not retain original spacing or YAML list structure. Extended parse behavior for block-local comments so serializer output can represent unnamed sections that begin with comments without inventing unsupported syntax.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No test suite was run, per developer-agent guardrails. Validation was limited to a compile-only Swift typecheck of the CookbookCore source files.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: `serialise(parse(x))` is intended to preserve `MealPlan` equality, not textual equality. Models containing empty unnamed sections still cannot be represented explicitly in `.menu` text because the format has no standalone marker for them.

conflict_risks: Low. The change is isolated to `MealPlanParser.swift`, but downstream tester/reviewer agents should evaluate parser behavior around canonicalized quantity/frontmatter formatting and unnamed-section comments.

execution_history.summary: Implemented `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` with canonical `.menu` output and adjusted comment parsing so unnamed sections can preserve leading comments within blocks.
